significance: A Hanuman temple of the Vadtal Gadi of the Swaminarayan Sampradaya, whose image was installed by Gopalanand Swami. Shastriji Maharaj carried out major rebuilding in 1899 under Kothari Gordhandas of Vadtal.
story: The image is said to be so charged that a single look at it drives out the spirits afflicting those who come here.
